title: Warcraft Rumble™ Gameplay Overview
summary: Grab your Miniatures, put them on the battlefield, and GET READY TO RUMBLE in the first Warcraft action-packed strategy game designed from the ground up for mobile!

title: Warcraft Rumble™ Revealed!
summary: Get ready to engage in a dazzling new sensation that’s sweeping the inns and taverns across the land with this action-packed mobile strategy game— coming soon to Android and iOS devices.

title: Warcraft Rumble: Arclight Surge Now Available in Beta
summary: Get ready for the Arclight Surge in the 0.9.3 beta update. Twice a week, two previously defeated Zones will overload with Arclight energy and create new challenges for you to overcome.

title: Warcraft Rumble: Jump into PvP with Beta Patch 0.9.4
summary: With the release of the 0.9.4 beta patch, players will get to jump into some truly epic PvP action.

title: Inside Warcraft Rumble: Creating a Mini
summary: Get an inside look at the creation process of a Mini with Art Director Jeremy Collins.

title: Developer Interview: Sit Down with Senior Animator Carin Huurnink
summary: It takes a team to make the magic of Warcraft Rumble come to life. Gather ‘round as Senior Community Manager Syless “Aezztra” Necole delves into more of Senior Animator Carin Huurnink's processes and inspirations.

title: Warcraft Rumble: PvP Changes in Beta Update 0.9.5
summary: With the release of the 0.9.5 beta update, players will be better prepared to cause chaos in PvP!

title: Warcraft Rumble: PvE Changes in Beta Update 0.9.5
summary: Go toe-to-toe against your foes with some high-impact PvE action. We’ve made campaign improvements, updated feature unlocks, and more!

title: Inside Warcraft Rumble: Calculating Mini Experience
summary: Get into the nuts and bolts of how the engineers of Warcraft Rumble ground Mini experience in keen storage solutions and data manipulation with Lead Engineer Andy Lim.

title: Beta Update 0.9.5 has Arrived!
summary: Beta Update 0.9.5 is here with more Talents, more Zones, and, most importantly, MORE CHAOS! There’s a little something for everyone in our latest beta update.

title: Smash That Button! Warcraft Rumble™ Enters Soft Launch
summary: We’re spreading the joy (and chaotically good fun) to more countries as Warcraft Rumble™ enters soft launch.

title: Pre-Order Warcraft Rumble on the Apple App Store – Now Available!
summary: It won’t be long before everyone around the world will be able to leap into all the joyful chaos Warcraft Rumble™ has to offer. Players can now pre-order through the Apple App store for the first time globally!

title: Warcraft Rumble Goes Live Globally, November 3!
summary: Experience the dazzling new sensation that’s been sweeping Azeroth, when Blizzard Entertainment’s mobile action strategy game Warcraft Rumble™ launches worldwide* on Android and iOS devices on November 3, live at BlizzCon 2023!

title: Mini Mondays: Alliance 3D Blueprints
summary: Bring the rumble to reality by 3D printing your own Warcraft Rumble Minis.

title: Mini Mondays: 3D Blueprints of Beasts
summary: Bring the rumble to reality by 3D printing your own Warcraft Rumble Minis.

title: The BlizzCon® Collection is on sale now!
summary: Celebrate BlizzCon with this set of Warcraft Rumble and Blizzard game digital goodies and more, now available on the Battle.net store.

title: Mini Mondays: Blackrock 3D Printer Blueprints
summary: Bring the rumble to reality by 3D printing your own Warcraft Rumble Minis.

title: Mini Mondays: Horde 3D Printer Blueprints
summary: Bring the rumble to reality by 3D printing your own Warcraft Rumble Minis.

title: Warcraft Rumble at BlizzCon® 2023 News Round-Up
summary: BlizzCon 2023 has ended but we have the latest Warcraft Rumble news coverage right here.

title: Lead the Way to Victory with Sylvanas Windrunner
summary: Collect the new playable Leader, Sylvanas Windrunner, during Season 1 of Warcraft Rumble beginning 28 October from the Guild Warchest and through PvP as a reward.

title: Mini Mondays: Undead 3D Printer Blueprints
summary: Bring the rumble to reality by 3D printing your own Warcraft Rumble Minis.

title: Warcraft Rumblings: A Warcraft Rumble Panel Recap
summary: Vice President & Game Director Tom Chilton, Production Director Jackie Bacal Head, and Art Director Jeremy Collins lift the lid and dive into the joyful chaos that went into Warcraft Rumble.

title: Mini Mondays: NPCs & Bosses 3D Printer Blueprints
summary: Bring the rumble to reality by 3D printing your own Warcraft Rumble Minis.

title: Warcraft Rumble Now Live Worldwide!
summary: Experience the dazzling new sensation that’s been sweeping Azeroth. Blizzard Entertainment’s mobile action strategy game Warcraft Rumble™ is now live worldwide* on Android and iOS devices!

title: Warcraft Rumble: Chaos Reigns in Season 2
summary: Get ready to bring your best to the battlefield in a brand-new Season of Warcraft Rumble, welcome a beastly new Troop, celebrate the Winter Holiday, and enjoy loads of action!

title: Warcraft Rumble: Season 3 Overview
summary: Get rumbling with a new season, new Leader, shiny new Cosmetics, and hefty PvP changes!

title: Patch Notes for Season 3 and update 4.0.0.
summary: Welcome to update 4.0.0! Check out plenty of PvP Improvements, now with random Maps and a new "Enchant" mod type! We've also increased Warchest Point rewards from PvP Honor, and made some adjustments and fixes to Troops, Leaders, Talents, and more!

title: Hotfix - 1/31/2024
summary: We've made some adjustments to Minis, Talents and Rocket Tower.

title: [Updated MAR 6] Find Your Juju in Season 4 with Witch Doctor
summary: The Voodoo is comin’ to Warcraft Rumble in Season 4. Introducing Warcraft Rumble’s newest Troop, Witch Doctor and two new emotes!

title: Season 4 Patch Notes
summary: The Voodoo is comin’ to Warcraft Rumble in Season 4. Check out this season's news and the changes coming to rewards, Daily Offers and quests.

title: Player Versus Player Update
summary: Beginning with Season 6, we’re going to make some adjustments to PvP. First, we’ll be improving player matchmaking to be more accurate. To do this, we’ll be looking closely at Leader Honor.

title: Come one Come all to the Darkmoon Faire
summary: Come one come all, Silas Darkmoon and his Darkmoon Faire will start making regular appearances in Warcraft Rumble later in Season 5. Once the Darkmoon Faire arrives, you can tap the Darkmoon Faire icon in the center of the map to complete challenges, earn prize tickets for you and your guild and then exchange tickets for marvelous rewards of your choice.

title: [Updated]Hotfixes: March 21, 2024
summary: We addressed a few PvP bugs, fixed the First Strike modifier and put the Gadgetzan map back in rotation.

title: Faerie Dragon is Ready for Danger
summary: Faerie Dragon, Warcraft Rumble’s newest Troop, is stealthing her way into your heart and your enemy's Barracks in Season 5. She’s bringing with her two new emotes, as well as something dark and mysterious.

title: Hotfixes: March 28, 2024
summary: Fixed an issue where players were unable to claim Tomes, as well as some user interface fixes and PvP changes.

title: Patch Notes for Update 5.0.0.
summary: What’s that?! A mysterious island has appeared! In this update we’ve addressed bugs in Arclight Surge, Campaign Missions, PvP and more.

title: Collect all the 💎SHINIES💎 in Blingtron's Bounties
summary: Blingtron will be visiting Warcraft Rumble frequently, his first appearance will be on April 24. Complete Blingtron's Bounties to earn Shinies that you can exchange for rewards of your choice.

title: Hotfixes: April 24, 2024
summary: We've addressed issues in PvP, Darkmoon Faire and increased Faerie Dragon's Phase Shift talent cooldown.

title: Step Right Up at the Darkmoon Faire
summary: Silas Darkmoon and the Darkmoon Faire will be creating chaos again on May 1, but this time something is different...

title: Claim Victory in Season 6 to Unlock New Rewards!
summary: Battle Ragnaros in the Molten Core raid, claim victory in the siege of Stormwind, and earn a new Cenarion Troop: Earth and Moon from the guild War Chest. Season 6 is going to be FIRE!

title: The Evolution of Faerie Dragon
summary: Faerie dragons, also known as sprite darters, blink dragons, fey dragons or fey drakes are diminutive, intelligent, and mischievous. Faerie dragons have a history that is nearly as intertwined into the story of Azeroth as that of the dragonflights.

title: Patch Notes for Update 6.0.0.
summary: Raids AND Sieges are here! Prepare to battle Ragnaros the Firelord in the Molten Core Raid, claim victory in the Siege of Stormwind, and unlock a new Cenarion Troop: Earth and Moon from the guild War Chest.

title: Hotfixes: May 3, 2024
summary: We've reduced the damage that spells deal to Barracks by 50%.

title: Turn the Tides of Battle with Earth and Moon
summary: Offense or defense – why not both? Use Earth and Moon, Warcraft Rumble’s newest spell to turn the tides of battle. Every time a Cenarion Mini is played, this hybrid spell will swap between Starfall for elemental damage or Entangling Roots for an area root that also applies poison.

title: Get Ready to lay Siege to Stormwind!
summary: Get ready to lay siege to the Alliance city of Stormwind! On May 29, you and a guildmate can battle through Stormwind to earn unique rewards.

title: Earn Powerful Rewards in Molten Core
summary: If you skipped leg day, you’d have a Molten Core too! On June 5, grab a guildmate and dive into the warm and inviting lava pools of Molten Core. Defeat Ragnaros for the ultimate prize: Ragnaros as a playable Leader.

title: Shop Updates Coming to Season 6
summary: For Season 6 we will be retiring some shop offers and introducing two new zone offers.

title: Claim your Daily Major XP Tome and Coins!
summary: Get 600 Coins instantly, log in every day for the next 30 days to claim your Daily Drop of 1 Major XP Tome and 120 Coins.

title: Invoke the Cenarion Family in Season 7
summary: Unlock the Cenarion Family during the Cenarion Summer Festival starting at the beginning of Season 7.

title: Season 7 Feature Patch Delayed
summary: The start of the Cenarion Festival, introduction of the new Cenarion Minis, Cenarion family dungeon and release of Moonglade will be delayed.

title: Season 7 Patch Notes
summary: All features across the game will now reset at the same time! We've also included some Cenarion Mini balance changes, improvements to challenges, improvements to dungeons and new Tomes!

title: Invoke the Cenarion Family in Season 7!
summary: Unlock the new Cenarion family during the Cenarion Festival starting on July 24.

title: Patch Notes: July 30, 2024
summary: This update includes improvements to the UI and feature responsiveness, performance optimizations and bug fixes.

title: [Updated Aug 15] Keep Enemies at Bay with Dryad in Season 8
summary: Season 8 introduces a new Cenarion Mini: Dryad, new Scholomange dungeon, changes to the dungeon and Arclight Surge rotations and more!

title: Season 9 Patch Notes
summary: Improvements to G.R.I.D, the tutorial and performance. We’ve added new G.R.I.D Overrides and included bug fixes for Moonkin’s Armoured trait and many more!

title: Enter the Emerald Dream in Season 9
summary: Unlock Ysera, the new Cenarion Leader and upgrade her during the Ysera event! Don’t miss Gadget Bonanza, Hallows End, a new Siege and more coming in Season 9!

title: Get Ready to lay Siege to Ironforge!
summary: Get ready to lay siege to the Alliance city of Ironforge! You and a guildmate can battle through Ironforge to earn unique rewards.

title: Hallow's End is Coming to Warcraft Rumble
summary: Hallow's End is coming to Warcraft Rumble on October 16. Earn 2 new Minis, new portraits, new cosmetics and more!

title: Save the Date for Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct on November 13
summary: Join us November 13 at 10:00 am PST for a special presentation celebrating 30 years of Warcraft and a look ahead at what’s next.

title: Log in for Epic Anniversary Rewards
summary: A Core Trader has been added, Anniversary Login Rewards have been added, Collection Level has been increased and more!

title: Get the Drop on New WoW, Hearthstone, and Warcraft Rumble Rewards
summary: Watch on Twitch or TikTok to earn new in-game viewership rewards for Hearthstone, Warcraft Rumble, and World of Warcraft.

title: Catch up on the Future of Warcraft with the Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct!
summary: It’s a big year for the Warcraft universe, and whether you’re a Hearthstone fan, you’ve joined the chaos in Warcraft Rumble, ventured into the world of Azeroth for the first time in Warcraft: Orcs and Humans, or you’re a World of Warcraft player, there’s something for everyone in our Warcraft 30th Anniversary Direct stream. Join us for a celebration as we dip into the mana pool of nostalgia and cast far sight on the future of all things Warcraft.

title: Get Ready for Warcraft Rumble's First Split Leader
summary: Collect the first playable split Leader, Sylvanas Windrunner, during a special event in Warcraft Rumble beginning Novermber 13.

title: Sow the seeds of victory in Pilgrim's Bounty
summary: Pilgrim's Bounty is coming to Warcraft Rumble on November 20, 2024. Earn 2 new Minis, player avatar, cosmetics and more!

title: Collect the New Split Leaders and Cosmetics During Winter Veil
summary: Winter Veil is coming to Warcraft Rumble on December 4, 2024. Collect the new Split Leaders, Winter Veil player avatar, Jinglebold Kobold skin and more!

title: Plant the Seeds of Protection with Malfurion Stormrage
summary: Unlock Malfurion Stormrage between December 4, 2024 and December 13, 2024. This powerful limited-time Mini is the perfect harmony of healing and defense. Shan'do or Shan'don't. There is no try.

title: Doomhammer is Bringing Mak'gora to Warcraft Rumble
summary: Orgrim Doomhammer never backs down from a challenge, especially a Mak'gora! Unlock this Horde and Blackrock Split Leader and the Jinglebold Kobold skin during his event from December 24 - January 2, 2025. That's not even his final form!

title: Complete Community Challenges to Earn Rewards!
summary: Work together as a community to complete three weeks of challenges and unlock rewards everyone can enjoy!

title: Summon Swarms of Carrion Beetles with Anub'arak
summary: Burrow underground and plague your enemies with swarms of Carrion Beetles using Anub'arak! Unlock Anub'arak and the Winter Veil player avatar during his event from December 14 - December 23, 2024.

title: PC Beta is Now Live!
summary: Celebrate the launch of the PC beta with us! Log in for Rewards, get Twitch Drops, check out the Winter Veil event, unlock the new Split Leaders and more!

title: Defend and Support Allies with the Ferocity of a Bear!
summary: Defend and support with the ferocity of a bear! Unlock the new shapeshifting Druid of the Claw Mini, during the Winds of Change event, starting on January 8, 2024. When times are tough, it's time to get tough!

title: Get Swole with Swole Troll
summary: Spin to win with Swole Troll, Warcraft Rumble's latest Siege Specialist. Unlock Swole Troll, during the Winds of Change event, starting on January 22, 2024. This cyclonic Mini has one thing on his mind, destroying enemy towers.

title: Patch Notes: Balance Changes
summary: We’ve made some balance adjustments to Ragnaros, Ancient of War, Earth and Moon, Faerie Dragon and more. We’ve also adjusted the difficulty for Missions in Moonglade and the Winter Veil – Sleighing Season Quest.

title: We've Reworked Player Versus Player!
summary: We've reworked Player versus Player with different rewards, shorter matches and Honor contribution! This update also includes bug fixes for matchmaking, daily offers, Anub'arak and more.

title: Challenge the Lich King and his Minions
summary: Take to the frozen wastes of Icecrown and battle Arthas at Icecrown Citadel. Defeat him and his minions in a series of 3 challenging maps with increasing difficulty to unlock this new Alliance and Undead Split Leader. Arthas will be the first Leader to receive skins. Alongside Arthas, we have plans for additional Mini skins that will be coming soon, some sooner than others.

title: Season 13 is Going to be Heroic!
summary: Season 13 is coming, bringing Arthas Menethil, the Lich King, as a new Alliance and Undead Split Leader. We've also added Army Loadouts, Leader Skins, Normal and Heroic difficulty Siege, and an avalanche of balance changes. Arthas will be the first Leader to receive skins. Alongside Arthas, we have plans for additional Mini skins that will be coming soon, some sooner than others.

title: Hotfixes: February 20, 2025
summary: Emotes can now be used in Siege and Raids! We've fixed issues with store purchases, the PC client, Druid of the Claw, Doomhammer and more!

title: Love is in the Air in Warcraft Rumble
summary: Blingtron, that lovable little bucket of bolts, is at it again, giving out sweet rewards to everyone who logs in. Beginning on February 12, 2025, log in daily to claim tickets and then exchange those tickets for a reward of your choice. Some of the rewards will include Tomes, Coins, Tinker Gems, Troops of your choice and more!

title: Master Holy and Discipline Healing with Priestess
summary: A dead Mini is a useless Mini. Right? RIGHT?! Priestess is a powerful healing and support focused Mini that can keep high health Minis alive, but does minimal damage. Priestess will be available during her event from February 26, 2025, to March 11, 2025. During the 2 week event, you can unlock her as a new Troop -- earn additional copies and the items needed to upgrade her.

title: A Remorseless Winter is Upon Us
summary: A chill is in the air. Can you feel it? A remorseless winter is upon us and a fearsome new Leader is blowing in on the northern winds. Careful not to catch Frost fever!

title: Take on the Challenge of Normal and Heroic Molten Core
summary: If you skipped leg day, you’d have a Molten Core too! Grab a partner and dive into the warm and inviting lava pools of Molten Core. Battle against all the fearsome foes some may expect to see in Molten Core, including the Firelord himself! Defeat Normal and Heroic difficulty to unlock Ragnaros as a Leader, Boost Slots, new golden Master Skins, new Split Leader Star Tomes and more!

title: Earn Epic Rewards in Heroic Stormwind Siege
summary: Get ready to lay siege to the Alliance city of Stormwind! Claim victory in the new Normal and Heroic difficulties to earn epic rewards!

title: Claim Epic Rewards in Normal and Heroic Ironforge Siege
summary: Ironforge, carved from the mountains of Dun Morogh in the central Eastern Kingdoms and named for the Great Forge that burns at the heart of the city, is the home of the dwarves. This hidden gem boasts massive stone passageways carved deep into the stone, an ornate Throne Room, and an underground Deeprun Tram that connects Ironforge's Tinker Town to Stormwind City's Dwarven district. Prepare to lay siege to Ironforge and claim victory in the new Normal and Heroic difficulties to earn sparkling gold skins and epic rewards!

title: Patch Notes: Season 13
summary: Season 13 is coming, bringing Arthas Menethil, the Lich King, as a new Alliance and Undead Split Leader. We've made adjustments to Leaders, Troops, and Frostwolf Shaman in PvP.

title: Hotfix for the Lich King Event and Heroic Stormwind
summary: We've slightly reduced the difficulty for Normal Lower Spire, fixed an issue with Lich King skipping phase transitions, and fixed an issue that kept Highlord Bolvar Fordragon from activating his Consecrate ability in Heroic Stormwind Siege.

title: Difficulty Adjustments for the Lich King Event
summary: We've reduced enemy income on all difficulties, reduced the level of Normal Missions by 1, and reduced the difficulty of Heroic Pit of Saron.

title: Hotfix: April 1, 2025
summary: Tap the shark in Booty Bay for a jaws-ome surprise! We've fixed issues with Polymorph and the Lich King's Soulshatter ability that would cause the game to crash.

title: Season 14 is Full of Friends, Family, and the Ultimate Battle for Number 1!
summary: Season 14 is packed with new challenges and features! Take on the challenge of Heroic Molten Core or throw down the gauntlet and challenge friends or foes to a duel in the new Friendly Duels feature. Unlock and upgrade Minis with the new Split Leader Star Tomes and Login event or discover Split Leaders and Headless Horseman in the G.R.I.D!

title: Throw Down the Gauntlet and Challenge Friends to a Duel
summary: Throw down the gauntlet and challenge friends or foes to a duel with the new Friendly Duels feature or see where you stand on the new Player versus Player Seasonal Leaderboard!

title: Patch Notes: Season 14
summary: We've reworked Bloodmage Thalnos, made some adjustments to under and over-performing Minis, including Vultures, Headless Horseman, Dryad, and Swole Troll, and fixed a few bugs that made some Minis less desirable.

title: 3D Print Your Favorite Minis
summary: New 3D Printer Blueprints are here! Bring the rumble to reality by 3D printing your own Warcraft Rumble Minis.

title: Patch Notes: Co-op Fixes
summary: In this update we've addressed multiple issues that have been affecting co-op play and one issue that affects Ragnaros in the Blackfathom Deeps dungeon.

title: Patch Notes: New Co-op Emotes!
summary: We've added new co-op emotes to help players better communicate during Siege and Raid. We've also addressed issues that have been affecting Arclight Energy, War Chest, and Guilds.

title: Master the Elements with Thrall in Season 15
summary: Blood and Thunder... and Chain Lightning? The Honorable Horde has taken over Season 15 and Thrall is ready for the challenge. Only the bravest heroes dare to strike the Horde where it hurts them most. Challenge Thrall at the gates of Orgrimmar to unlock him as a new Horde Leader!

title: Patch Notes: Honorable Horde Balance Changes and Bugfixes
summary: We've made some adjustments to Arthas as well as fixed bugs with Thrall, Gnomeregan, and the Honorable Horde event.
